content.title: How to Watch Dodgers vs. Phillies NLDS Game 3 - October 8
content.text: The Los Angeles Dodgers will host the Philadelphia Phillies in the third game of the NLDS on Wednesday at 9:08 p.m. ET, live on truTV, TBS, and HBO Max from Dodger Stadium. The Phillies will look to avoid being swept after losing the first two games of the series.
